numbers.name: R Arcizet 2006 Fig. 4 (5 power curves pooled)
criteria
numbers.value: PASS |R| <= 0.15 in both; FAIL |R| > 0.35 in either; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise

note: INCONCLUSIVE under Test Card T042 (approved before the figures were opened; one run). Arcizet: |R| = 0.040 is inside the PASS limit, but the pairs come only from the tails (|phi| about 1.5 to 2.9): on the blue side the points between phi = 0.3 and 1.5 sit at damping ratio near 0 on the bottom axis and were not read, so the red peak (ratio up to about 7 near phi = -0.7) has no partner. This is a property of the measurement (on the blue side the damping cannot be measured below 0, where the resonator self-oscillates), not of the reader. Benevides: R = 0.217 with a large reading spread (0.106) because the panel is about 180 x 80 pixels. Two deviations were entered with the calibration after approval and before computing R: an exclusion box for the Arcizet inset and a 3 x 3 opening to separate its markers from same-colour fit lines. Not UET-distinct: the linear optomechanics model predicts R = 0. Recorded at L1; the claim stays L1.
